remarks: Two bedroom deluxe Fractional ownership at the premier Tamarack Club. Newly renovated fourth floor unit that allows you to rent one side and use the other during your weeks. Ownership amenities include underground parking while lodging overnight, or access to the valets, year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, two hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private owner's lounge and locker rooms. Ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per year or about 1 week per month on a rotating basis.
